Strategy: Relative dead-zone avoidance. Exact fits score highest; post-placement residuals smaller than a quarter of the item score far below looser fits, since such gaps are tiny at this item scale; larger residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit would leave a residual below a quarter of the item. It may help by avoiding unusable waste at this scale, but may fail if later items are much smaller than the current one.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-100.0 + (r - item) if r - item < item / 4 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Relative dead-zone avoidance: residual below item/4 penalized, exact fit highest, else Best Fit.
